chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from al-Wassa from Dawud ibn Sirhan from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Do not eat in vessels of gold and silver.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on eating in gold and silver vessels in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes the prohibition of eating and drinking from gold and silver vessels, a ruling rooted in the concept of *zuhd* (asceticism) and the avoidance of *israf* (extravagance). In Shia jurisprudence, this is often understood as a recommended prohibition (*mandub*) or absolute prohibition (*hukm*) depending on the school of thought, emphasizing humility and distinguishing daily use from ceremonial display. The chain of narration highlights the transmission of this etiquette through the prominent scholars of the Imams' era, reinforcing its authenticity and practical application in Muslim life.
